project.title: RecallGuard AI — IBM Db2 Powered Intelligent Food Recall Platform
project.short_description: Traces a contaminated ingredient lot through production and distribution with IBM Db2 recursive SQL, scores risk transparently, and uses five CrewAI agents to produce a verified, evidence-backed, targeted recall plan for human approval.
project.category: AI Agents / Supply-Chain Traceability / Food Safety

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker) or Db2 on Cloud; Db2 12.1.2+ for VECTOR retrieval
ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db / ibm_db_dbi; langchain-db2 (DB2VS); CrewAI tools over ibm_db
features_used: CLOB JSON storage of agent outputs
VECTOR type / VECTOR_DISTANCE via langchain-db2 (when available)

ai_models: Configurable via CrewAI: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / watsonx.ai Granite / Ollama
